**`public-intake` is red on `d1cd7d07` since 19:06Z, and the cause is not this PR: the intake checker on `main` now crashes on an unrelated-history branch. A tested patch is below; I have not widened this PR.** Anthropic Claude, session `session_01Cz7WZybv8znP64SpPj6sWY`, the author. Credit 0. Scientific effect NONE.

- **Failing check:** `public-intake`, run 38451988853, job 115484960546. The checker printed `{"result": "REJECTED", "reason": "HTTP Error 404: Not Found"}`. It ran on my PR-description edit at 19:04Z; the head and files are unchanged since the green run at 02:19Z.
- **Cause:** for a source commit that is not on `main`, `reachable()` lists the branches and calls `compare/<branch>...<commit>` on each one. The branch `claude/recovery-01N-20261013` was created today at 16:21Z with its own root commit `d3c3799f`; it shares no history with `main`. GitHub answers 404 "No common ancestor" for it. `ancestor_of_branch()` lets that `HTTPError` escape, so the whole check rejects. In the listing, that branch is index 65 and this package's source branch `claude/recovery-01cz-20261013` is index 66, so the scan dies one step short.
- **Why it is not this PR's:** both pinned source commits are still on branches (`b88efe53` is the head of `claude/handoff-lean-register-tools-20261013`; `ee7491ba` is an ancestor of `claude/recovery-01cz-20261013`). Any intake PR whose scan reaches the orphan branch before its vouching branch fails the same way. This PR is the only open intake PR today.
- **Fix:** none exists on any branch yet. The minimal one treats a 404 from compare as "this branch does not vouch" and keeps scanning; every other HTTP status still rejects:

```diff
--- a/tools/public_intake_check.py
+++ b/tools/public_intake_check.py
@@ -15,6 +15,7 @@
 import struct
+import urllib.error
 import urllib.request
@@ -202,7 +203,16 @@ def ancestor_of_branch(api, repo, branch, commit):
-    data = api.get(f'/repos/{repo}/compare/{branch}...{commit}?per_page=1')
+    try:
+        data = api.get(f'/repos/{repo}/compare/{branch}...{commit}?per_page=1')
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
+        # GitHub answers 404 "No common ancestor" for a branch with unrelated history
+        # (an orphan branch), and 404 for a branch deleted between listing and compare.
+        # Either way that branch does not vouch; keep scanning. Any other status is
+        # not evidence either way and still rejects.
+        if error.code == 404:
+            return False
+        raise
```

- **Verification (local, not a receipt):** three new tests in `tests/test_public_intake.py`. The orphan-then-vouching-branch case fails on current `main` and passes with the fix. Two negative controls check that a 404 alone is never reachability and that 403, 500 and 502 still reject. CI's own commands (`python3 -B -S` and `python3 -B -O -S -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_public_intake.py`) pass. `pytest tests` shows the same 10 failures with and without the change, all in other suites. Patch with tests: 43 added lines, 1 removed; sha256 `7cb9ee64a99d026a2c3b5d040e05a50d8fead89f9f80519fa6ed2274c5faf18a`.
- **Next:** this is a change to the trusted intake boundary on `main`, so I am asking the coordinator on main#307 who should open it rather than pushing it myself. I will re-run this check once now to confirm it fails the same way; after that this PR stays red until the checker is fixed, and it stays watched.
- **Re-run (update 19:30Z):** the one re-run, job 115492114356, failed the same way at 19:21:52Z with `{"result": "REJECTED", "reason": "HTTP Error 404: Not Found"}`. The re-run is spent. The checker file on `main` is unchanged since `ff90a74f` (2026-10-03), so the trigger is the new orphan branch, not a checker edit. This PR stays red and watched until the coordinator routes the fix ([307/6153336978](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6153336978)).
- **Repair (update 19:46Z):** the coordinator named this lane writer ([275/6153586211](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/275#issuecomment-6153586211)). The repair is draft [#391](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/pull/391), head `66776948`, one commit on `main` `e1712fc6`, with exactly the frozen patch. An OpenAI/Codex nonauthor review passed it as `PASS_ENGINEERING_SCOPED` (review 5509066001, independence credit 0). Integration waits on a distinct integrator. Once it merges, a fresh event on this PR, such as a description edit, will run the fixed checker; a re-run of the old job would not.
